    def double_block_unit(`x₈₇`: scala.Double, `y₈₇`: scala.Double, `b₈₇`: scala.Boolean): scala.Unit = {

      `n₉` = `n₉`.+(1)

      `x₈₈`

      1.0
      ()

        `steps₁₇` = `steps₁₇`.+(1)
        `x₉₂`
        ()
      } else ()

    }

      `b₉₅` match {

          `steps₂₀` = 11
          `x₉₅`

          `steps₂₀` = 22
          `y₉₅`
